title: the commons intentions fold into the schematic: 19-the-roots.md and section entries, the md files gone
intention: The homeless intentions live as lines in cairn/devices/cairn/requirements/: the roots as 19-the-roots.md, the rest in the sections they belong to; the md files are gone and nothing points at them.
why: Two statements of one intention drift apart; the outline is the one Akien reads, and a builder should find the roots in the same folder as everything else.
traces_to: Law 1 (one settled statement, read not re-derived) and Law 5 (the address carries what a mind needs now).
how: Distill each md to intention + why, add only the lines the outline lacks, repoint the readers, remove the mds through the artifact door, reseal the touched components.

clauses.claim: 19-the-roots.md is a piece TOC.md names, and it carries every CORE_VALUES narrative and why, whitespace-normalised
no tracked cairn file outside validations/ and history.json names intentions-not-beside-code/<a folded name>.md, scratch fixtures excepted

decisions.text: D1: the roots piece 19-the-roots.md (telos, core values, vision, learning block, Rule 1, learning gates) and the missing entries 0.10, 3.3.2.1, 3.4.4.2, 9.3.2.1, 9.4.2.3.8-9, 10.3.11, 17.1.3.2.1, 17.15.1; TOC.md names 19.
D2: the two proofs that read an md intention read a requirements piece: test_core_values pins the CP words against 19-the-roots.md; test_quorum addresses 19-the-roots.md as its real concept-piece.
D3: every comment, docstring, charter field and doc pointer at a folded md names its requirements line instead.
D4: the 8 open tickets owned by an md are owned by cairn/devices/cairn/intention+why.json.
D5: the md intentions leave CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/ through cairn artifact remove; review-cc-patterns-for-cognition-gates.md, a third-party review, moves to CairnCommons/reviews/.
D6: the proof, one tooth per clause.

orient.intent: Distill the 26 md intentions in CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code to intention + why lines in the requirements folder (a new 19-the-roots.md for telos, core values, vision, learning block, Rule 1, learning gates; single entries elsewhere for what the outline lacks), remove the md files, and repoint every reader: two proofs that open one, comments, charter fields, docs, and 8 open tickets owned by one.
orient.scope: IN: the requirements lines and TOC entry; the two pinning proofs; pointer edits in code, charters and docs; the 8 tickets' owning_intention; removing the mds (review-cc-patterns moves to CairnCommons/reviews/); reseals of every touched component. OUT: the folder's JSON machinery and its glob readers (ticket 2b); charter prose (ticket 3); CLAUDE.md beyond pointers (ticket 4); commons history records.
